explanation: Adds two leaf modules. direction.ts owns dirGlyph and directionTextColor(direction, tier), the only colour for result text that states a direction (the AA text tokens, coloured for the fdr tier only). listingWords.ts owns the listing-mode words (leadingTracks, notLeading, noneLeads) and nominalCaveat(kind?). ListingModeToggle takes its tooltip clause from nominalCaveat with unchanged words; crossStudyListing.ts is untouched.
